# Punisher weapons

Weapons (kind 31) only the Punisher can equip: daggers and bows.

Class page: [[wiki/classes/4-punisher\|Punisher]]. The weapon decides the skills: Q/W/E/R are the weapon's four normal skills (`WeaponBase`).

28 items.
